svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ArabicaAI architecture: batch data, online service, users and managed services
svg.desc: The organizers' Amazon S3 bucket is read once into a Python and DuckDB pipeline: Bronze Parquet, typed Silver tables, a quality gate and Gold tables with the reviewed serving slice. The slice is loaded by hand into Cloudflare D1. A Cloudflare Worker serves the Angular app and the API for customers, agents and admins, keeps every SQL statement in one file, and is deployed by GitHub Actions. Amazon Cognito signs people in with an email code, Amazon SES sends status emails, and Google Cloud Vertex AI runs the offline evaluation; in the demo, extractor v2 on Vertex AI reads the details of an "I can't find it" report after the response. The Worker never reads S3, DuckDB or Silver.
svg.text: main after v0.3.0 and #116 (2026-10-04) · every path is deployed or built · the Worker never reads S3, DuckDB or Silver
make pipeline · runs offline, never online
no refund, block or fraud verdict
Offline evaluation · a model only reads, deterministic code decides (ADR-006)
builder never sees the frozen set
Not deployed: the AWS Lambda + RDS and GCP targets are priced designs only (Docs/Costs). Sources: SYSTEM_DESIGN.md, DATA_ENGINEERING.md, EVALUATION.md, ADR-002 to ADR-014.
Icons: Simple Icons (CC0), trademarks of their owners; Vertex AI shown with the Google Cloud mark.
